results.title: Hugging Face launches ProtoStar open science and AI initiative | ETIH EdTech News — EdTech Innovation Hub
results.content:
Participating organizations retain control over what they release and how it is shared. Their commitments are set out in non-binding, non-exclusive memoranda of understanding with Hugging Face.

Hugging Face reports that researchers shared more than three times as many new science datasets on its platform in the first nine months of 2026 as in the same period of 2025. It also reports that fully documented datasets account for 90% of dataset downloads on the Hub. [...] #### A climate challenge spanning 210 cities

Carnegie Mellon University is hosting the first ProtoStar challenge, Climate Risk Intelligence, from November 2 to 13, 2026.

Teams will use historical weather records from 210 US cities to predict annual conditions for 2019–2025. Forecast inputs must use records dated no later than December 31, 2018, preventing teams from feeding the actual outcomes into their predictions. [...] Previous

message.content:
## Recent developments
- **Nvidia Acquisition and DOJ Scrutiny:** The U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ) initiated inquiries into Nvidia's proposed $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face. The probe, which surfaced in late October 2026, focuses on potential impacts on AI market competition and Nvidia's prospective control over a premier model distribution channel.
- **Leadership & Open-Source Commitment:** Hugging Face CEO Clem Delangue has publicly reaffirmed the company's commitment to fighting for open-source and open-weight AI following the acquisition announcement and changes surrounding Jensen Huang's involvement. Co-founders continue to champion open-weight models as foundational to industry progress.
- **Launch of "ProtoStar":** Hugging Face partnered with universities via the Open Forum for AI (OFAI) to launch **ProtoStar**, an open science initiative designed to put public research to work with AI. Carnegie Mellon University hosted the inaugural ProtoStar challenge focusing on Climate Risk Intelligence in early November 2026.

## Talking points
- **Regulatory Landscape:** Discuss how the DOJ’s antitrust inquiry into the Nvidia acquisition may affect Hugging Face's timeline, operations, and developer ecosystem.
- **Independence of the Hub:** Address how Hugging Face plans to maintain neutrality as the central hub for open-source AI models if it becomes a subsidiary of a hardware titan like Nvidia.
- **Open Science & Research Growth:** Highlight the momentum behind Hugging Face's scientific initiatives, noting that fully documented dataset downloads account for 90% of hub downloads, alongside the success of the ProtoStar initiative.

## Open questions
- What specific structural or operational remedies is Hugging Face prepared to offer regulators to address antitrust concerns regarding model distribution control?
- How will the partnership with Nvidia impact independent contributors and competing cloud providers who rely heavily on the Hugging Face hub?
- What are the long-term goals for ProtoStar, and how will academic collaborations scale in the wake of corporate integration?

## Sources
- [Nvidia + Hugging Face: 5 DOJ Probe Risks [2026]](https://shattered.io/nvidia-hugging-face-doj-inquiry-12-93b-meta-becerra-pac-2026)
- [Hugging Face cofounder: Open-weight AI models were 'our savior'](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/hugging-face-cofounder-open-weight-ai-models-were-our-savior-220000916.html)
- [Hugging Face CEO vows to keep fighting for open-source AI after Jensen Huang’s exit](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/12/hugging-face-ceo-vows-to-keep-fighting-for-open-source-ai-after-jensen-huangs-exit)
- [Hugging Face launches ProtoStar open science and AI initiative | ETIH EdTech News — EdTech Innovation Hub](https://www.edtechinnovationhub.com/news/hugging-face-and-universities-launch-protostar-to-put-public-research-to-work-with-ai)
- [CMU to Host Challenge to Put Scientific Data to Work With AI - News - Carnegie Mellon University](https://www.cmu.edu/news/stories/archives/2026/october/cmu-to-host-challenge-to-put-scientific-data-to-work-with-ai)
